_comment: Rent roll = the source of truth for expected monthly rent per property, used to compute pending rent and arrears. SCAFFOLDED from observed payments (Jun-Aug 2026) — PLEASE VERIFY every 'monthly_rent' and tenant mapping. Any entry with "verify": true had an unclear/variable amount and is a best guess. 'match' tells the engine how to attribute a transaction to this property: adriana units match by 'account_label'; directly-managed match Checking-account rows whose Description contains ANY string in 'name_any' (case-insensitive). 'start_month' (YYYY-MM) is when arrears begin accruing for this tenant — set it to the lease start or the first month you want counted, so old history doesn't inflate arrears. Remove a property or set active:false to exclude it.
